coordinate_system.description: For physical measurements: origin at tube butt centre; +Y along tube toward sensor tip; X across keys, +Z toward key faces. Pivot is the chosen grip centre in this frame.
coordinate_system.cad_note: Existing CAD has local frames. Do not treat the R4 preview’s short rod reference as the full tube, or its local sensor/carrier origins as an assembled placement. R2 GLB has a full illustrative tube and tip translation; it is a design reference, not a measurement.

model_limits: All unmeasured values stay null. A known subtotal is not assembled mass.
Point-mass component inertia excludes each part’s own distributed inertia; the uniform tube includes it. This is a comparative rigid-body model, not measured hand tremor or comfort.
No cut, print, fit, sensor replacement, or pointer setting change is implied.

illustrative-lengths.status: Legacy illustrative hypotheses only; 90 mm is not a measured grip, and listed lengths are bare tube lengths, not the preferred overall prototype length.
illustrative-lengths.assumption_basis: Earlier side-chat arithmetic inputs. The ambiguous80–100mm keys/grip wording was later corrected to a roughly100mm key lower edge, not a grip pivot. Retain these numerical axes only as hypothetical comparisons.
illustrative-lengths.placement: Tube occupies Y=0..length; tip package is a point at Y=length; near-grip package is a point exactly at the grip pivot. All centres have X=Z=0.
illustrative-lengths.comparison: Retain the same packages and grip distance from the butt at each length. Compare transverse X inertia and signed gravitational torque with the wand horizontal.
illustrative-lengths.limits: Range is an envelope over the listed assumed endpoints, not a confidence interval. Near-grip package extent and human grip/arm dynamics omitted. No optimal length claim.
illustrative-lengths.range_input_scope: Hypothetical axes and tip masses, not bounds on the current hand pivot or a confidence interval.

preferred-geometry-sensitivity.status: Illustrative sensitivity for the selected physical V3 CAD envelope, not a measured hand model
preferred-geometry-sensitivity.pivot_scope: Numerical rotation axes for comparison only; not anthropometric estimates or a measured pivot range.
preferred-geometry-sensitivity.tip_point_scope: Two illustrative locations for the whole lumped tip mass; the PCB geometric centre is not the centre of mass of the complete board-holder-wires package.
preferred-geometry-sensitivity.wire_scope: Per-gram coefficient for a uniform straight segment from key-row centre to the assumed tip location; actual wire mass, loops, endpoints and insulation are unmeasured.

physical-v3.alias_scope: New physical prototype brief; not firmware Control V3 or historical holder R3.
physical-v3.status: User-selected 180 mm overall; referenced CAD placement and collision checks passed, physical fit remains unverified
physical-v3.preference_reason: Latest explicit user choice: eighteen centimetres overall. This supersedes the earlier30cm preference and is not a mathematical optimum.

cad_reference.status: Referenced CAD revision may still show an earlier envelope; compare source overall_length with preferred_overall_length_mm before treating it as current.

physical-v3.cutting_status: Overall envelope and derived nominal tube length are CAD assumptions, not a physical cut instruction or measured fitted length.
physical-v3.existing_layout_evidence: Approximate100mm lower key-cluster edge describes the existing layout. It is not a fixed placement requirement for the new180mm prototype or a hand pivot.
